ctaHeading: Altona's trade services are ready — let's get it done.
aboutText: Based in Altona, ATM Property Maintenance has been serving Melbourne's western suburbs with expert electrical, carpentry, and maintenance services. Our team is skilled, reliable, and ready to handle everything from safety compliance checks to property upgrades for sales or long-term care. We pride ourselves on quality workmanship and affordable excellence for residential, commercial, and real estate clients.
servicesText: We offer a comprehensive range of trade services including electrical work, carpentry, safety and compliance checks, heating and cooling installations, and builder partnerships. Our multi-trade team ensures quality assurance and timely delivery across Melbourne.

services.title: Electrical Services
services.desc: Expert electrical work for homes and businesses, including repairs, installations, and safety inspections to meet Australian standards.

services.title: Carpentry & Cabinetry
services.desc: Skilled carpentry services from custom cabinetry to fencing, ensuring precision and durability for all your property needs.

services.title: Safety & Compliance Checks
services.desc: Comprehensive safety and compliance inspections for properties, helping you meet legal requirements and maintain value.

services.title: Heating & Cooling
services.desc: Professional installation and maintenance of heating and cooling systems to keep your property comfortable year-round.

services.title: Maintenance & Repairs
services.desc: Reliable maintenance and repair services for all property types, addressing issues promptly to prevent costly damage.

services.title: Builder Partnerships
services.desc: Collaborating with builders for subcontracting work, providing quality trade services to support construction projects.

reviews.text: ATM Property Maintenance did an excellent job on our home's electrical rewiring and safety check. They were professional, timely, and Altona-based, which was a bonus.

reviews.text: We hired them for carpentry work on our shop fit-out in Altona. The craftsmanship was top-notch, and they handled everything from cabinetry to door installations.

reviews.text: As a property manager, I rely on ATM for regular maintenance and compliance checks across our Altona properties. Their reliability and skill make them my go-to trade team.
